text: Assignment three. A janitor's closet. Except... it isn't.
Behind the door, a staircase going down. Thirteen steps. A landing. Then thirteen more.
They give me a flashlight. Seventy-five watts. Anything brighter... the dark just eats it.
I can only ever see one and a half flights ahead.
Then I hear it. A child. Crying. Somewhere below me.
They say it's two hundred meters down. So I keep walking.
Fifty landings. A hundred. The crying never gets any closer.
Then my light catches something... on the next landing.
A face. No pupils. No nose. No mouth.
I run. Up. Thirteen steps. Turn. Thirteen steps. Turn.
I reach the door. It's locked. From the outside.
So I knock. And I knock. For two weeks... nobody opens it.
